games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses the Unit 7 verb pattern correctly?
choices: She decided applying for the scholarship.
She enjoys to practise interviews.
She decided to apply for the scholarship.
She finished to write her report.
rounds.answer: She decided to apply for the scholarship.
rounds.explanation: Decide takes to plus the infinitive, so she decided to apply is the only correct pattern.

rounds.prompt: Nora said, 'I have just posted the article.' Which reported version is correct?
choices: Nora said that I had just posted the article.
Nora said me that she had just posted the article.
Nora says that she has just posting the article.
Nora said that she had just posted the article.
rounds.answer: Nora said that she had just posted the article.
rounds.explanation: Reported speech backshifts have posted to had posted and changes the pronoun I to she.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence means the same as 'If you do not water the seedlings, they will die.'?
choices: Unless the seedlings die, you will water them.
Unless you water the seedlings, they will not die.
Unless you water the seedlings, they will die.
If you water the seedlings, they will die.
rounds.answer: Unless you water the seedlings, they will die.
rounds.explanation: Unless means if not, so unless you water them keeps the original warning unchanged.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: What does the word abtirsiinyo describe in the review of Unit 1?
choices: It is the Somali tradition of reciting the family line, which can stretch back twenty generations or more.
The story itself survives, because heritage lives in memory and language as much as in objects.
Classmates who had hidden their own work began submitting poems, comics and essays, and the writing club grew past twenty members.
rounds.answer: It is the Somali tradition of reciting the family line, which can stretch back twenty generations or more.
rounds.explanation: The passage explains that abtirsiinyo tells a person their ancestry, their clan, and their place in the community.

rounds.prompt: Why did Imani defend Kian when the teacher's motorcycle was stolen?
choices: The story itself survives, because heritage lives in memory and language as much as in objects.
They included participation logs proving that Form 3 had not been negligent during the last clean-up day.
She believed he was innocent until proven guilty and refused to let suspicion punish a quiet new student.
rounds.answer: She believed he was innocent until proven guilty and refused to let suspicion punish a quiet new student.
rounds.explanation: The motorcycle was found abandoned near the river the next day, which proved Kian had done nothing wrong.

rounds.prompt: What evidence did the students include with their letter about the Saturday cleaning rule?
choices: A hearing reviewed the testimonies, discovered that a loose screw had caused the damage, and exonerated him completely.
They included participation logs proving that Form 3 had not been negligent during the last clean-up day.
Max used printed posters, sweets and lunchtime music, while Imani used hand-drawn posters, honest speeches and promises of work.
rounds.answer: They included participation logs proving that Form 3 had not been negligent during the last clean-up day.
rounds.explanation: The logs mattered because the principal later confirmed Form 3 had cleaned more consecutively than any other form.

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Which Unit 4 word describes someone who is very happy because good news has just arrived?
choices: famished
oblivious
wary
elated
rounds.answer: elated
rounds.explanation: Elated means very happy about good news; famished means hungry, oblivious means unaware and wary means careful.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence is written in the present passive?
choices: The rangers planted new trees last month.
New trees are planted along the trail every year.
The club will plant trees tomorrow.
Planting trees is enjoyable for everyone.
rounds.answer: New trees are planted along the trail every year.
rounds.explanation: The present passive pairs are with a past participle: trees are planted.

rounds.prompt: Which Unit 6 review word names facts or information that help prove a claim is true?
choices: evidence
analogy
perseverance
rhythm
rounds.answer: evidence
rounds.explanation: Evidence names the facts that prove a claim; analogy, perseverance and rhythm mean quite different things.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: Which review word from Unit 1 means 'to make someone very angry'?
choices: acknowledge
infuriate
endeavour
demonstrate
rounds.answer: infuriate
rounds.explanation: To infuriate someone is to make them very angry; acknowledge, endeavour and demonstrate carry no sense of anger.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses a participle adjective correctly?
choices: The film was bored, so we left early.
We felt boring during the film.
The film was boring, so we left early.
The bored film sent us to sleep.
rounds.answer: The film was boring, so we left early.
rounds.explanation: A film causes the feeling, so it is boring; the people watching it are the ones who feel bored.

rounds.prompt: Which technique from Unit 3 gives human actions to something that is not human?
choices: personification
alliteration
rhyme
simile
rounds.answer: personification
rounds.explanation: Personification gives human actions to non-human things, such as saying the wind danced.
